exact_results: For every finite coordinate type iota and actual exponent function alpha : iota -> Nat, Nat.multinomial univ alpha <= card(iota)^(sum alpha).
Consequently (sum alpha)! <= card(iota)^(sum alpha) * product_i alpha_i!, with both Nat and exact real-cast versions.
proof: Apply the pinned finite multinomial theorem at coordinate values one. The actual alpha belongs to the finite antidiagonal at sum alpha, so its nonnegative multinomial coefficient is at most the whole sum card(iota)^(sum alpha). Nat.multinomial_spec supplies the exact factorial identity; no combinatorial count is assumed.
semantic_checks: No positivity or nonemptiness premise is imposed on the coordinate type. For empty coordinates the total degree is zero and the bound reads 1<=0^0*1=1.
Zero entries and total degree zero are included using ordinary natural factorial and natural powers.
The real result casts the exact natural inequality and finite product, with no approximation or rounding.
The factor card(iota)^(sum alpha) is explicit and remains part of any derivative-bound consumer.
